mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 1% signals weakening demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where RSAFS falls > 1% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings for cyclically-sensitive sectors and drags on the S&P 500, producing negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where INDPRO falls > 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate above 0.25 percentage points signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points combined with a decline in average hourly earnings (HOUST) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp AND HOUST falls in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp AND HOUST falls (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 1% combined with a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening demand and construction activity, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls > 1% AND HOUST falls in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where RSAFS falls > 1% AND HOUST falls (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5% combined with a decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 1% signals weakening manufacturing and demand, which reduces earnings for cyclically-sensitive sectors and drags on the S&P 500, producing negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls > 0.5% AND RSAFS falls > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where INDPRO falls > 0.5% AND RSAFS falls > 1% (t-test p > 0.05).
